name: aisre
services:
  api:
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@postgres:5432/aisre
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: [REDACTED]
    networks:
      default: null
    build:
      context: /Users/arif/Projects/AI SRE
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_started
        required: true
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 8000
        published: "8000"
        protocol: tcp
  postgres:
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: aisre
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    networks:
      default: null
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: pgdata
        target: /var/lib/postgresql/data
        volume: {}
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 5432
        published: "5432"
        protocol: tcp
networks:
  default:
    name: aisre_default
volumes:
  pgdata:
    name: aisre_pgdata
